items.source: You may not want a certain repository, a query method on a repository, or a field of your entity to be exported at all. Examples include hiding fields like password on a User object and similar sensitive data. To tell the exporter to not export these items, annotate them with @RestResource and set exported = false.
items.translation: 您可能不希望导出某个仓库、仓库上的查询方法或实体字段。例如，需要隐藏User对象上的password字段以及其他类似敏感数据。若要指示导出器不导出这些项，请使用@RestResource注解进行标记，并将exported设置为false。

items.source: It is important that you override both delete methods. In the interest of faster runtime performance, the exporter currently uses a somewhat naive algorithm for determining which CRUD method to use. You cannot currently turn off the version of delete that takes an ID but export the version that takes an entity instance. For the time being, you can either export the delete methods or not. If you want turn them off, keep in mind that you have to annotate both versions with exported = false.
items.translation: 务必同时重写 两个 delete 方法。出于提升运行时性能的考虑，导出器当前采用一种较为简单的算法来决定使用哪个 CRUD 方法。目前，您无法禁用接受 ID 的 delete 版本，而仅导出接受实体实例的版本。暂时而言，您可以选择导出或不导出 delete 方法。如果您希望禁用它们，请注意必须同时用 exported = false 注解这两个版本。

items.source: These snippets of JSON assume you use Spring Data REST’s default format of HAL. You can turn off HAL, which would cause the output to look different. However, your ability to override rel names is totally independent of the rendering format.
items.translation: 这些 JSON 片段假设您使用的是 Spring Data REST 的默认格式 HAL。您可以关闭 HAL，这将导致输出外观有所不同。然而，覆盖 rel 名称的能力与渲染格式完全独立。

items.source: All query method resources are exposed under the search resource.
items.translation: 所有查询方法资源均通过 search 资源暴露。

items.source: Projections provide the means to change what is exported and effectively side-step these settings. If you create any projections against the same domain object, be sure to NOT export the fields.
items.translation: 投影提供了更改导出内容并有效绕过这些设置的方法。如果您针对同一域对象创建任何投影，请确保不要导出字段。
